description: This file is a shell script designed to manage the restart and control of hostapd processes and Wi-Fi interfaces, specifically for a Hotspot configuration. It includes functions to restart hostapd, checks Hotspot enable status via dmcli, and interacts with network interfaces using ifconfig and other system commands.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Function to restart hostapd related processes and reconfigure interfaces for restarting Hotspot services.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Function to kill hostapd processes and bring interfaces up, intended for restarting hostapd services.
